title: BeforeIT.jl: High-Performance Agent-Based Macroeconomics Made Easy
abstract: arXiv:2502.13267v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: BeforeIT is an open-source software for building and simulating state-of-the-art macroeconomic agent-based models (macro ABMs) based on the recently introduced macro ABM developed in [1] and here referred to as the base model. Written in Julia, it combines extraordinary computational efficiency with user-friendliness and extensibility. We present the main structure of the software, demonstrate its ease of use with illustrative examples, and benchmark its performance. Our benchmarks demonstrate that the base model built with BeforeIT is orders of magnitude faster than its original Matlab implementation, while achieving performance comparable to a highly optimised HPC implementation. translated_title: BeforeIT.jl：让高性能基于主体的宏观经济学变得简单
translated_abstract: BeforeIT 是一个开源软件，用于构建和模拟最先进的宏观经济基于主体模型，该软件基于最近提出的宏观经济 ABM 开发（见文献[1]，本文称之为基础模型）。它使用 Julia 语言编写，兼具卓越的计算效率、易用性与可扩展性。我们介绍了该软件的主要结构，通过示例展示了其易用性，并对其性能进行了基准测试。基准测试结果表明，使用 BeforeIT 构建的基础模型比其原始 Matlab 实现快几个数量级，同时达到了与高度优化的高性能计算（HPC）实现相当的性能。此外，我们展示了 BeforeIT 如何支持轻松构建模型变体（例如文献[2]中的“CANVAS”模型），如何通过自动化多国预测流水线大规模评估这些变体，以及如何……
tldr: BeforeIT.jl 是一个用 Julia 编写的开源宏观经济基于主体模型仿真软件，其性能比原始 Matlab 实现快几个数量级并可媲美高度优化的 HPC 实现，同时兼具易用性和可扩展性。
en_tdlr: BeforeIT.jl is an open-source Julia software for agent-based macroeconomic modeling that runs orders of magnitude faster than the original Matlab implementation and matches highly optimised HPC performance, while remaining user-friendly and extensible.
